posts.caption: Four chords, one slow melody. Grand Piano in C major, played with two hands in the air.

daily.title: Dreamy Piano
daily.note: The classic four chords on Grand Piano. Hold a chord with your left hand and sing a melody with your right.

posts.caption: Lo-fi Rhodes in A minor for your study playlist. Play this sound and loop your own.

daily.title: Lo-fi Rhodes
daily.note: Warm Rhodes in A minor at 74 BPM. Keep it slow and leave space between notes.

posts.caption: Campfire nylon guitar in D major. Simple enough to learn tonight.

daily.title: Campfire Nylon
daily.note: Nylon guitar in D major. Try strumming the chords and answering with short melody runs.

posts.caption: Strings Ensemble in D minor. Every movie trailer starts somewhere.

daily.title: Cinematic Strings
daily.note: Big strings in D minor. Long notes, slow hands, then go up an octave for the ending.

posts.caption: Sunday morning in G major. Coffee, sunlight, Grand Piano.

daily.title: Sunday Piano
daily.note: A bright G major piano tune. Take it at your own tempo.

posts.caption: D Dorian on Rhodes. That raised sixth is where the soul lives.

daily.title: Neo-Soul Rhodes
daily.note: Rhodes in D Dorian, rocking between the one and four chords. Lean on the 7th.

posts.caption: Front porch fiddle in D major. Hands up, feet tapping.

daily.title: Front Porch Fiddle
daily.note: A quick violin tune in D major at 120 BPM. Eighth notes, big smile.

posts.caption: A whole choir in your pocket. C minor, Choir Aahs, no singers needed.

daily.title: Pocket Choir
daily.note: Choir Aahs in C minor. Hold each note and let the chords breathe.

posts.caption: A little bossa nova on nylon guitar, A minor at 108.

daily.title: Bossa Nylon
daily.note: Nylon guitar in A minor with a bossa lilt. Play the melody a little ahead of the beat.

posts.caption: Rain on the window, E minor on the piano.

daily.title: Rainy Window Piano
daily.note: Grand Piano in E minor at 72 BPM. Quiet, slow, a little sad.

posts.caption: Indie clean guitar in E minor. Same four chords as half your playlist.

daily.title: Indie Clean Guitar
daily.note: Clean electric guitar in E minor. Arpeggiate up the wheel, then hold the high note.

posts.caption: Walking upright bass in F. One note per beat, never stops moving.

daily.title: Walking Upright Bass
daily.note: Upright Bass in F major. One note per beat, stepping toward the next chord.

posts.caption: The world’s smallest violin, now in B minor.

daily.title: Sad Violin
daily.note: Solo violin in B minor. Slide slowly between the notes for the full effect.

posts.caption: Golden hour Rhodes in F major. Starts on the four chord so it never quite lands.

daily.title: Golden Hour Rhodes
daily.note: Rhodes in F major starting on IV. A warm, unresolved loop.

posts.caption: Anthem strings in B-flat. Big notes, bigger feelings.

daily.title: Anthem Strings
daily.note: Strings Ensemble in B-flat major. Hold every note for two beats and go high at the end.

posts.caption: A Dorian on clean guitar, the classic one-to-four groove.

daily.title: Dorian Guitar
daily.note: Clean guitar in A Dorian, moving between the one and four chords. Bluesy but bright.

posts.caption: Late-night vibraphone. ii–V–I in B-flat, the jazz handshake.
Marimba bounce in G major. Hard not to dance to this one.
Kalimba in E major. Soft, sparkly and very calming.
Main character trumpet in B-flat. Play it walking into a room.
Cathedral choir in F major. Long notes and a lot of echo.

daily.title: Cathedral Choir
daily.note: Choir Aahs in F major. Two beats per note, no rush.

posts.caption: Upright bass groove in G Dorian. Bass players, this one is yours.

daily.title: Upright Dorian Groove
daily.note: Upright Bass in G Dorian. A funky one-to-four riff with ghosted repeats.

posts.caption: Midnight Rhodes in C minor. Lights low, volume lower.

daily.title: Midnight Rhodes
daily.note: Rhodes in C minor at 70 BPM. Let the minor 7th ring.

posts.caption: Violin sunrise in A major. Slow start, big finish.

daily.title: Violin Sunrise
daily.note: Solo violin in A major. Build from low and slow to the high C-sharp.

posts.caption: Haunted choir in D minor. Play it with the lights off.

daily.title: Haunted Choir
daily.note: Choir Aahs in D minor at 60 BPM. Slow, dark, and just a bit spooky.
